title: AAPS 2.8.2 change language will not change it
symptom: In AAPS 2.8.2, changing the language from 'System default' to German does not change the interface; it remains in French even after restarting AAPS.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause, but it is described as a recurring bug that has existed for a long time, sometimes working on some fields.
fix: Select 'System default' in AAPS settings and change the language in the Android settings, then it works perfectly.
evidence_quote: Select System default in AAPS settings and change language in your android setting, then it works perfectly.
